ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 80% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) and 20% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity (white) mottled regions localized at the distal lateral margins (tips) of both lobes. Central and proximal fluke regions consist of a dominant, low-intensity (black) contiguous field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 112 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 0.15 relative to the central fluke area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations is highest (approx. 5-15 pixels) at the outer thirds of each lobe, decreasing in frequency toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a moderately concave trajectory from the median notch extending to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (diameter 4-12 pixels) distributed across the dark medial regions, with the highest density observed on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detected several unaligned linear pixel disruptions; most prominent are a vertical high-intensity streak at the peduncle junction and diagonal rake-like marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of high-contrast, rough-textured extrusions (barnacles) localized on the extreme leading and trailing edges of the distal tips; several small V-shaped nicks along the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated vertical white pigment streak located precisely on the central axis of the peduncle-fluke transition.
